messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: SEV=high · group=gpu-alloc-metrics · symptom=rapid-gpu-memory-growth on cluster eu-west1-a

pagerduty: Paging: https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/INC-4473219876 · triggered by rule `cuda_mem_pressure >= 92% for 3m`

anna: Acked. I'm on it.

raj: Seeing repeating CUDA OOM on pool gpu-pool-eu-west1-a-*[2-5] — logs show `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` and nvml memory usage 98%+ on affected GPUs.

chris: Copy. Running quick check: `rg "CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY" /var/log/containers | head -n 5` shows same PID across containers — suspecting KV cache leak after recent kvcache changes.

anna: Taking lead. I'm going to quiesce new traffic to that pool and evict long-lived KV cache sessions. Quick mitigation: `./ops reroute --pool gpu-pool-eu-west1-a --dest fallback-cpu-eu --drain 30s`

mx-bot: Command accepted: reroute started · 8 routes shifted · estimated 120s until steady-state.

raj: While reroute runs, can we drop batching for affected model variants? `scale-targets` patch ready.

chris: Pushed an emergency config: `model.config.batch_max_tokens=256` -> applied to model-rlhf-v2 on pools matching eu-west1 -> confirmed via HAProxy health check.

sara: Customer dashboard: 2 paying customers (acme-inc, travelly) show elevated 503s and token timeouts from eu region. Notifying SEs. Ticket created: TCK-7891.

leo: Suggest grabbing a heap profile of the runner process before restart: `gcore` + upload to /tmp/oom-dumps for offline analysis.

anna: Did a graceful restart of the runner on pool node gpu-pool-eu-west1-a-3 -> `systemctl restart redwood-runner` -> svc came back. Memory immediately dropped from 98% -> 34% on that GPU.

pagerduty: Escalation timer paused (acked by anna).

raj: After two node restarts and reroute, mem pressure trending down cluster-wide (graphs: p95 mem usage -> 67%). Still seeing a few OOMs in 10m window but not cascading.

chris: Follow-up: rolling restart of kvcache-workers on pool completed (3/3). Logs show `kvcache: closing stale session` messages.

anna: Running smoke tests and warmup for rerouted traffic. Latency p50 back to normal for most customers; acme-inc still borderline — SEs are contacting them.

sara: Noted customer comms: SE @mira will send interim update.

leo: Created short postmortem stub in docs: /incidents/4473219876-kv-cache-leak-detection.md (will expand after dump analysis).

mx-bot: Monitoring set: watch `cuda_mem_pressure` for eu-west1-a with alert window 2m -> escalation if >85% sustained.

anna: Marking mitigations done for now. Keeping thread open for dump analysis and RCA.

incident-bot: Alert status: mitigated · monitoring · incident owner=anna · incident link=https://incidents.redwood.com/4473219876

anna: handing off to next oncall (leo) for overnight watch. I'll update RCA in the morning. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo: Taking handoff. I'll keep an eye and kick if anything regresses. Thanks team :thumbsup:
